name: CTR: Coco Team Racing
summary:
The game where Coco is the main character. Well, actually she’s the villain.

This CTR mod aims to be somewhat a different take to custom tracks project, more of a “complete experience”, adventure mode centred, with a couple of side content. It does not include any custom tracks other than the ones made by its author. Roughly around 1h30-2h00 to explore all content.
